consumer_pin.note: Pin consumers (IB-Odoo_19 requirements.txt, Constellation.Gate and EIE pyproject) to release_commit_sha until a GitHub Release exists; do not pin floating main.

artifacts.note: No release artifact built yet for 1.1.0; consumers install from the release commit via git+https.

agreement_rules: package_version must equal pyproject.toml [project].version at release_commit_sha
release_tag must resolve to release_commit_sha once created
HEAD may advance beyond release_commit_sha while package_version remains 1.1.0 only if consumers pin release_commit_sha (not HEAD)
claiming HEAD as the released identity while HEAD != release_commit_sha is a FAIL
every consumer of the coordinated set pins the same release_commit_sha; a split pin (one consumer on a commit lacking GateClient.execute) is a FAIL
